description: Earlier outage postmortems in the library: the article as markdown sections, its title, and its publish date.

title.description: The article's own title, as written at the top of the article.

published_date.description: The date the article was first published, as the page states it next to the title or byline. Not a date of the outage and not the date of a later update. Empty if the page states no publish date.
